verdict.rationale: Adyen documents a Terminal API that lets a POS app make payments, issue refunds, collect shopper information and run other terminal interactions. It uses JSON messages with no libraries required, over either a local network or the cloud. Related docs cover POS-initiated tipping, referenced and unreferenced refunds, and a test environment. The HN comment about a COM integration is a dated anecdote that itself notes JSON-driven readers were coming, so it does not contradict the current docs. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of a modern Terminal API integration, and detailed evidence of the cloud (server-to-terminal) request and response flow beyond the brief local/cloud mention.
